column2: [intro]
I’m an eccentric pop star,
My style is unique and quite bizarre.
But there’s one thing that makes me shiver,
When seams are showing, it makes me quiver.
Hide those seams, I beg of you,
I don’t want my little flaws in view.
Everything must be perfect, from start to end,
In my world, no seams to offend.
I wear haute couture dresses,
But visible seams are pure distress.
I want everything smooth and free of flaw,
So people see only my beauty in awe.
Hide those seams, I beg of you,
I don’t want my little flaws in view.
Everything must be perfect, from start to end,
In my world, no seams to offend.
[ solo ]
I’m an eccentric pop star,
With dreams and seams that are quite bizarre.
But no matter, I’ll shine bright and clear,
And dance on stage without a fear.
[outro]
